body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Reply is Received in Saleshandy trigger (Zoho) on Production, all 6 activities (AL-4219 fix confirmed, the workflow starts for a reply):

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create/Update a Contact in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho: one contact created with the mapped Contact Fields and one note. Existing contact with an old Title: the same contact is updated and no second contact is made. | Pass |
| 2 | Create/Update a Lead in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho: one lead created with the mapped Lead Fields and the prospect company, and one note. | Pass |
| 3 | Create/Update Account in Zoho | Prospect with a company and no contact: account created with the company name and the mapped Account Fields, not linked to a contact. | Pass |
| 4 | Create/Update a Deal in Zoho | Contact with 2 deals: only the newest deal is updated and the older deal is unchanged. Prospect not in Zoho, Closing date 7: one deal created with the Closing Date set 7 days ahead, not linked to a contact. | Pass |
| 5 | Create a Task in Zoho | Contact created, then one task linked to it with the configured Subject, Status, Priority and the due date set 3 days ahead. | Pass |
| 6 | Combined actions | Contact, Deal and Task together: one contact, one linked deal, one linked task, and a note on each. | Pass |

**Note:** Every check marked the prospect as replied from the Emails tab three-dot menu. AL-4217 (Mark as replied button missing on the Emails tab for some users), AL-4199 and AL-4218 (Email Sent bugs) are still open and not covered by this verification. A blank account next to a new deal is known (a deal creates its own account), and Pipeline and Stage cannot be chosen on the Deal action.
waitingFor: QA to send via npm run jira. Source: Zoho Reply Received production smoke, 2026-11-04 (sequence 989765, account emailopenedprod); 8 of 8 passed over two runs, reports/zoho-reply-received-smoke.
